input:
CURRENT SCENE:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

ITEMS:

[I298] 【古代的时候】有一个人叫神农   correction: 古代的时候 → 在古代   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 古代的时候 -> 在古代 (corrected 18/30 in train)
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: 在古代[有一个神农→有一个叫神农的老人]
  her past correction: ⟦很久以前，在古代⟧有一个叫神农的老人 — her note: “很久以前“ and ”在古代” are redundant, only keep one
  her past correction: 这是[一个神农的→关于神农的]古代故事

[I299] 他需要当【上】医   correction: 上 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (redundant_words, Other): Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <deleted part> is redundant because <the remaining word(s)> already expresses this meaning.  Her terms: redundant, redundant with是, redundant with看起来
  her past correction: 他现在是[-当]医生 — her note: redundant with是
  her past correction: 他那[不是成为→没有当]医生 — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong
  her past correction: 他[-那]不是成为医生

[I300] 他需要当上【医】   correction: 医 → 医生   strength: error
  checker's note: 医 alone is not the usual word for a doctor here
  rule card (redundant_words, Other): Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <deleted part> is redundant because <the remaining word(s)> already expresses this meaning.  Her terms: redundant, redundant with是, redundant with看起来
  her past correction: 他现在是[-当]医生 — her note: redundant with是
  her past correction: 他那[不是成为→没有当]医生 — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong
  her past correction: [+他]就生病了 — her note: otherwise it is ambiguous who gets sick

[I301] 【一看】别的人就想帮助他们   correction: 一看 → 一看到   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 一看 -> 一看到 (corrected 10/15 in train)
  rule card (perception_look_see, Vocabulary): 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person actually sees/catches sight of <thing or situation>, so use 看到, not 看.  Her terms: 看look vs.看到see, no了, 看look, 看到see
  her past correction: [-他]想帮他们 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 他[+就]想帮忙
  her past correction: [-他]想帮忙 — her note: redundant

[I302] 【他】不知道什么东西能做药   correction: 他 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 他 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: [-他]看到了药 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: ⟦它⟧可以做药 — her note: “它“ is unclear, it seems that it refers to夹竹桃，which is a poison, not a medicine
  her past correction: [-他]决定找出什么植物可以吃

[I303] 神农听说【^】一个远远的地方有一种植物   correction: ∅ → 在   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 神农[发现→发现了]很多植物 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 神农[什么想尝→想尝什么植物]
  her past correction: 神农[加→吃]下去很多的植物

[I304] 神农听说一个【远远】的地方有一种植物   correction: 远远 → 很远   strength: suggestion
  checker's note: 很远的地方 is the standard expression
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 神农[发现→发现了]很多植物 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 神农[什么想尝→想尝什么植物]
  her past correction: 神农的朋友给[+了]他这植物 — her note: 了completed

[I305] 什么病人吃【^】都会觉得身体更好   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 有的人吃的生病[+了]
  her past correction: 感觉得身体健康[+了]
  her past correction: 有的人吃[的→了以后]生病

[I306] 神农三个月【走去】   correction: 走去 → 走着   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 走去 -> 走着 (corrected 5/5 in train)
  rule card (zhe_durative, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 着 for a durative, accompanying, or static state. When one action accompanies the main action, use V.着 + V2 (for example, 牵着驴走).  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <V> is a durative/accompanying action while <main action> happens, so use 着 (着durative).  Her terms: 着durative, 了completed, V.着
  her past correction: 神农一走路就[-走]到了
  her past correction: 神农一走[-路]就走到了
  her past correction: 神农很常[走去→走着]找饭 — her note: 走着durative

[I307] 找到有【^】植物的地方   correction: ∅ → 这种   strength: error
  checker's note: it should refer to the specific plant mentioned earlier
  rule card (search_find, Vocabulary): 找 means “look for.” Use 找到 when the person successfully finds something.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person successfully finds <object>, so use 找到, not 找.  Her terms: 找look for vs.找到find
  her past correction: 他[找有的花→找到一种植物] — her note: 找look for vs.找到find
  her past correction: 他找到了很多[-的]中国的植物
  her past correction: 找到了很多[对做好饭→能做饭]的植物

[I308] 他看到一【个】很漂亮的植物   correction: 个 → 株   strength: error
  checker's note: 株 is the measure word for plants
  rule card (perception_look_see, Vocabulary): 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person actually sees/catches sight of <thing or situation>, so use 看到, not 看.  Her terms: 看look vs.看到see, no了, 看look, 看到see
  her past correction: 他一[看→看到]植物就吃 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction: 然后他们[看了→看到了]很多植物 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction: [看很多植物→看到了很多植物] — her note: 看look vs.看到see

items.explanation: 古代 is the location/time setting, so use 在+Place before the action: 在古代有一个人叫神农。
It would be more natural to delete 上. 当 already expresses becoming a doctor here.
Use 医生 for “doctor”; 医 alone is not the usual word for a doctor here.
He actually sees the other people, so use 看到see, not 看look.
他 is already clear from the close continuation, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.
It would be more natural to say 在一个很远的地方有一种植物, using 在+Place for the location.
It would be more natural to say 很远的地方. 很远 is the standard expression here.
It would be more natural to add 了: 吃了都会觉得身体更好. 了 shows the eating action is completed before they feel better.
Walking is a durative action while he finds the place, so use 着durative: 走着。
This refers to the specific plant mentioned earlier, so add 这种: 有这种植物的地方。
Use 株 as the measure word for plants.
